out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing.

out_items.name: Food-contact surfaces cleaned and sanitized

violations.title: Food Contact Surface, 4 Hour Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed knives, pizza cutter, and tongs located at the prep tops that are not being cleaned at least every 4 hours.
violations.corrective_action: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils must be cleaned and sanitized at least every 4 hours to prevent contamination by bacterial growth. CDI cleaned

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: garlic in oil, garlic in chimichurry oil at room temperature.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI discarded. Discussed again how garlic and oil must be kept cold to prevent botulism risk

out_items.name: Proper date marking and disposition

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: salsa verde, queso, and moldy butter.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. CDI discarded

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: quail eggs, plantain chips, sliced ham, salsa and cooked corn.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. CDI marked

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Proper Cooling
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: cool food in shallow container without lid. Observed corn sitting on stove at 125f and gazpacho cooling with lid on in WIC
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. CDI lids removed and put in shallow pan to coo.. Bella Vita Pizza, Dyfre's Burger, La Taqueria DC (Inspection Date: 06/09/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: knife in equipment cracks,
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. CDI stored in clean location

out_items.name: Food-contact surfaces cleaned and sanitized

violations.title: Chemical Sanitizing, Contact Time Met
violations.observation: Chemical sanitizer immersion time was not adequate for quat sanitizing solution. Observed PIC dip thermometer in solution for 10 seconds.
violations.corrective_action: Chemical sanitization (manual or mechanical operations) including the application of sanitizing chemicals by immersion, manual swabbing, brushing, or pressure spraying methods using a solution by providing: 1) an exposure time of at least 10 seconds for a chlorine solution, 2) an exposure time of at least 7 seconds for a chlorine solution of 50mg/L that has a pH of 10 or less and a water temperature of 100F or a pH of 8 or less and a water temperature of 75F, 3) an exposure time of at least 30 seconds for other chemical sanitizing solutions, or 4) an exposure time used in relationship with a combination of temperature, concentration, and pH that when evaluated for efficacy yields sanitization. CDI dipped for 1minute.

violations.title: Food Contact Surfaces Clean to Sight & Touch
violations.observation: The following equipment/utensils were observed soiled to sight and touch: colorful woven baskets observed with food debris encrusted within the basket. Observed basket used to serve sausage and potatoes. No liner to separate food from surface.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be clean to the sight and touch. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. CDI items washed and sanitized. Do not use for TCS food items, only use for chips and use a food liner. Discard baskets that cannot be cleaned.

out_items.name: Hands clean and properly washed

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: Observed staff not washing their hands as required when changing tasks or entering the kitchen for their work shift or after handling raw animal proteins.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. EHS INSTRUCTED STAFF TO WASH HANDS EFFECTIVELY AT THE HAND SINK. SEE FACT SHEET ON HAND WASHING SENT VIA E-MAIL IN SPANISH FOR MORE INFORMATION.

violations.corrective_action: Food prepared in a private home may NOT be used or offered for human consumption in a food establishment. EHS INSTRUCTED THE OWNER TO DISCARD THE CAKE IMMEDIATELY.

out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Parasite Destruction
violations.observation: Observed shrimp on the menu that is not cooked and the owner has no letter for Parasite Destruction.
violations.corrective_action: Before service or sale in ready-to-eat form, raw or partially cooked fish shall be: 1) frozen and stored at a temperature of -4F or below for a minimum of 7 days in a freezer, or 2) frozen at -31F or below until solid and stored at -31F or below for a minimum of 15 hours, or 3) frozen at -31F or below until solid and stored at -4F or below for a minimum of 24 hours. EHS INSTRUCTED THE OWNER TO CALL THE SEAFOOD VENDOR TO OBTAIN THE REQUIRED PARASITE DESTRUCTION LETTER FOR SHRIMP. ENSURE CORRECTION WITHIN 3 DAYS. PIC CALLED SUPPLIER AND IS WAITING FOR LETTER CONFIRMATION. DO NOT SERVE UNDERCOOKED SEAFOOD UNTIL LETTER IS OBTAINED. COOK ALL SEAFOOD TO 145F.

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: FOOD IMPROPERLY STORED INSIDE THE WALK-IN REFRIGERATOR TO INCLUDE: A) RAW SEAFOOD ON SHELVES ABOVE COOKED FOODS, 2) RAW BEEF AND RAW EGGS ON SHELVES ABOVE PIZZA DOUGH, ETC.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EHS INSTRUCTED THE OWNER TO START THE RE-ORGANIZATION OF THE WALK-IN REFRIGERATOR AS DISCUSSED TO SEPARATE OUT THE RAW ANIMAL FOODS LIKE RAW EGGS, RAW SEAFOOD, RAW PORK, RAW BEEF, AND RAW CHICKEN FROM ALL OTHER FOODS LIKE SAUCES, VEGETABLES, AND COOKED ITEMS. Bella Vita Pizza, Dyfre's Burger, La Taqueria DC (Inspection Date: 04/11/2025) Page 2 of 6

violations.title: Gloves, Use Limitation (Single-Use Gloves)
violations.observation: Single use gloves observed improperly used in the following manner: 1) STAFF MEMBER USED SINGLE USE GLOVES TO HANDLE RAW HAMBURGER AND THEN TO HANDLE OTHER ITEMS LIKE TAKE HOME CONTAINERS.
violations.corrective_action: If used, single-use gloves shall be used for only ONE task and used for no other purposes. The single-use gloves shall be discarded when damaged or soiled or when interruptions occur in the operation. EHS INSTRUCTED THE STAFF MEMBER TO REMOVE THE GLOVES, DISCARD THEM, WASH HIS HANDS, AND PUT ON NEW GLOVES. EHS ALSO INSTRUCTED THE STAFF MEMBER TO DISCARD THE SINGLE SERVICE ITEMS THAT WERE TOUCHED AND CONTAMINATED.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Disclosure

out_items.name: Food properly labeled, original container

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Observed food, beverages, fryer oil, etc stored in direct contact of the floor in the kitchen areas and dry storage area (upstairs).
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EHS INSTRUCTED THE OWNER THAT NOTHING SHALL BE STORED DIRECTLY ON THE FLOOR. ELEVATE ALL ITEMS AT LEAST 6 INCHES OFF THE FLOOR USING PROPER NSF SHELVING UNITS OR DUNNAGE RACKS. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Non-food contact surfaces clean

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: 1) PLUMBING UNDER SINKS, 2) SHELVING UNITS, 3) STORAGE UNITS UNDER WORK TABLES, 4) SINKS, 5) HOOD FILTERS, 6) EXTERIOR OF THE STAND MIXER.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. EHS INSTRUCTED THE OWNER TO PERFORM A THOROUGH, DEEP CLEANING OF THE ENTIRE FACILITY BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP. THEN CLEANING SHALL BE MAINTAINED DAILY.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Floors/Walls/Ceilings, Smooth, Easily Cleanable
violations.observation: Observed the improper type of ceiling panels in all 3 restrooms.
violations.corrective_action: Floor, floor covering, walls, wall covering, and ceiling must be designed, constructed and installed to be smooth and easily cleanable. EHS INSTRUCTED THE OWNER THAT THE CEILING PANELS IN THE RESTROOMS SHALL BE EASILY CLEANABLE, NON-ABSORBENT, AND WASHABLE. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION IN 6 MONTHS.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the kitchen walls are need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. EHS INSTRUCTED THE OWNER TO SCRUB ALL KITCHEN WALLS AND PAY ATTENTION TO AREAS BEHIND AND UNDERNEATH EQUIPMENT AND SINKS. ENSURE CLEANING BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed missing or damaged ceiling panels in the kitchen where the mop sink is located.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. EHS INSTRUCTED THE OWNER TO REPAIR OR REPLACE THE DAMAGED/MISSING CEILING PANELS AND ENSURE ANY SMALL HOLES/GAPS IN THE CEILING PANELS ARE SEALED. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP. Bella Vita Pizza, Dyfre's Burger, La Taqueria DC (Inspection Date: 04/11/2025) Page 4 of 6

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Protective Shielding on Light Bulbs
violations.observation: Observed no light shields on one kitchen ceiling fixture.
violations.corrective_action: Provide shielded light bulbs to prevent possible physical contamination to foods. EHS INSTRUCTED THE OWNER TO REPLACE THE LIGHT SHIELD BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.
